parameters.query:
INSERT INTO agents_inventory (agent_id, hostname, ip_address, status)
SELECT '{{ $json.agent_id }}', 'host-' || '{{ $json.agent_id }}', '{{ $json.dst_ip }}'::inet, 'active'
WHERE NULLIF('{{ $json.agent_id }}', '') IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (agent_id) DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO nvd_vulnerabilities (cve_id, description, cvss_score, severity)
SELECT '{{ $json.associated_cve }}', 'Cached by Astrea SOAR Pipeline', {{ $json.cvss_score }}, '{{ $json.severity }}'
WHERE NULLIF('{{ $json.associated_cve }}', '') IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (cve_id) DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO security_incidents (
  source_detection,
  alert_name,
  rule_id,
  src_ip,
  src_country,
  src_reputation_score,
  dst_ip,
  dst_port,
  agent_id,
  affected_software,
  associated_cve,
  calculated_risk_score,
  status
) VALUES (
  'HYBRID',
  '{{ $json.alert_name }}',
  '{{ $json.rule_id }}',
  '{{ $json.src_ip }}'::inet,
  '{{ $json.src_country }}',
  {{ $json.cti_score }},
  '{{ $json.dst_ip }}'::inet,
  {{ $json.dst_port }},
  NULLIF('{{ $json.agent_id }}', ''),
  '{{ $json.software_banner }}',
  NULLIF('{{ $json.associated_cve }}', ''),
  {{ $json.risk_score }},
  'ENRICHED'
)
RETURNING incident_id, status, calculated_risk_score, agent_id, src_ip;

UPDATE security_incidents
SET status = 'CONTAINED_AUTOMATICALLY',
    active_response_executed = 'isolate-host, block-ip',
    active_response_status = 'SUCCESS',
    response_payload = jsonb_build_object(
      'action', 'containment',
      'commands', jsonb_build_array('isolate-host', 'block-ip'),
      'agent_id', '{{ $('Risk Score Calculation').item.json.agent_id }}',
      'src_ip', '{{ $('Risk Score Calculation').item.json.src_ip }}',
      'executed_at', NOW()
    )
WHERE incident_id = '{{ $('Insert Incident PostgreSQL').item.json.incident_id }}'::uuid
RETURNING incident_id, status, active_response_executed, active_response_status;

UPDATE agents_inventory
SET status = 'isolated'
WHERE agent_id = '{{ $('Risk Score Calculation').item.json.agent_id }}';
